tex_content.html:
Theorem
[ASCR and AVR under Ricci flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0108 1. ch19:19.21–19.22\group Asymptotic Geometry

For a complete ancient solution with bounded nonnegative curvature operator, $\operatorname {ASCR}(g(t))$ is independent of time. For a complete solution with bounded nonnegative Ricci curvature and curvature tending to zero at spatial infinity, $\operatorname {AVR}(g(t))$ is independent of time (and the decay condition propagates forward).
